name: Mandelbrot
title: Mandelbrot set
about: The Mandelbrot set drawn point by point in 256 colours (MODE 28).

name: Plasma
title: Plasma (palette cycling)
about: A 256 colour plasma written straight into screen memory, then animated by cycling the palette with COLOUR n,r,g,b.

name: Fire
title: Fire
about: The classic fire effect: a heat map averaged upwards, turned into colours with ColourTrans and written to screen memory a word at a time.

name: Stars
title: Starfield
about: 300 stars flying towards you on a double-buffered screen. Cursor Up/Down change the speed.

name: AsmBars
title: Raster bars (ARM code)
about: Raster bars filled by an ARM code routine called with CALL, which writes screen memory found with OS_ReadVduVariables. Double buffered.

name: AsmPlot
title: ARM assembler + CALL
about: The inline assembler: a moire pattern drawn by SWI OS_Plot from machine code, and stripes written into screen memory.

name: Cube
title: Double-buffered cube
about: A rotating wireframe cube drawn on two screen banks swapped with *FX 112 and *FX 113.

name: Sprites
title: Bouncing sprites
about: Shaded balls built pixel by pixel in a sprite area (with masks) and plotted with OS_SpriteOp 34 on a double-buffered screen.

name: Lissajous
title: Lissajous figures
about: Turning Lissajous figures x=SIN(a*t+p), y=SIN(b*t) with ghost trails, for eight ratios a:b.

name: Roses
title: Rose curves
about: Twelve rose curves r=COS(k*t) for fractional k, drawn in colour.

name: Spiral
title: String art spiral
about: String art: straight lines in 256 colours make curves.

name: Circles
title: Circles
about: Concentric circles, spokes and EOR-plotted ellipses in the 16 colour MODE 12.

name: Colours
title: 256 colours
about: The 256 colour palette: 64 GCOL colours times 4 tints.

name: Tree
title: Fractal tree (recursion)
about: A fractal tree drawn by a recursive procedure with LOCAL variables and GCOL r,g,b.

name: Life
title: Game of Life
about: Conway's Game of Life on an 80 x 56 board. R: random soup, G: Gosper glider gun, C: clear.

name: Hanoi
title: Towers of Hanoi
about: The Towers of Hanoi with seven discs, solved by a recursive procedure and animated on two screen banks.

name: MouseTest
title: Mouse test
about: Shows which mouse buttons a program sees as pressed (MOUSE x,y,b and INKEY -10/-11/-12), counts presses, and draws in each button's colour while it is held. Handy for checking the browser's mouse mapping: Select = 4, Menu = 2, Adjust = 1.

name: Snake
title: Snake (game)
about: The game of Snake. Cursor keys (or Z X ' /) steer; eat the apples and don't hit the walls or your tail.

name: Ball
title: Bouncing ball
about: A bouncing ball plotted with exclusive-OR (GCOL 3) and WAIT.

name: Voices
title: The ROM voices
about: Plays each of the nine ROM sound voices in turn with VOICE and SOUND: WaveSynth, StringLib and Percussion.

name: Canon
title: Canon (six channels)
about: A Pachelbel-style ground bass on six channels, queued a bar at a time on the BEATS/TEMPO scheduler with SOUND c,a,p,d,beat.

name: Tune
title: SOUND and the beat scheduler
about: A short two channel tune queued on the beat counter with SOUND ...,beat, VOICE and STEREO.

name: WimpClock
title: Wimp clock (desktop task)
about: A clock written as a Wimp task: an icon bar icon, a window redrawn every second from Wimp_PollIdle, and a menu. Only runs in the desktop.

name: Teletext
title: MODE 7 teletext
about: MODE 7 teletext: colour codes, double height, flashing, backgrounds and graphics.

name: Sieve
title: Sieve benchmark
about: The Sieve of Eratosthenes benchmark: 1899 primes, ten times, timed.

name: Guess
title: Guess the number
about: Guess the number between 1 and 100, with INPUT.

name: Errors
title: Error handling
about: ON ERROR, LOCAL ERROR, RESTORE ERROR, ERROR, ERR, ERL and REPORT$ at work.
